import re

def replace_bracketed_synonyms(text, mapping):
    """
    Replaces [word] with mapping[word] if present.
    Leaves other text unchanged.
    """
    def repl(match):
        key = match.group(1)
        return mapping.get(key, key)
    return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", repl, text)
